## Purpose and Runtime Model
COG is a local-first, markdown-based “second brain” framework. AI coding/agent clients interpret skill playbooks, read and mutate a vault, and optionally call external integrations; Git and optional iCloud provide persistence/sync. There is no application server or database. Primary entry guidance is `AGENTS.md`, with client-specific roots in `CLAUDE.md`, `GEMINI.md`, and `.cursorrules`.

## Agent-Surface Distribution
The authoritative full implementation is the Claude surface: skills and specialist-agent playbooks under `.claude/skills/` and `.claude/agents/`. Equivalent plugin-standard skills are shipped under `skills/`; Antigravity has pointer stubs in `.agents/`; Kiro and Gemini expose a core subset via native command formats.
- `.claude/skills/onboarding/SKILL.md`
- `skills/onboarding/SKILL.md`
- `.gemini/commands/onboarding.toml`

## Vault as the Data Boundary
User state is plaintext Markdown organized as a PARA-like vault. Skills classify incoming material, write daily/project/knowledge artifacts, and later synthesize those artifacts. Framework instructions and user content are intentionally separated so updates can replace framework files without overwriting personal data.
- `00-inbox/`
- `01-daily/briefs/`
- `02-personal/braindumps/`
- `03-professional/braindumps/`
- `04-projects/`
- `05-knowledge/`

## Skill-Orchestrated Workflows
Skills are declarative operational entry points rather than executable application modules. They cover capture and synthesis (braindump, briefs, consolidation), team/product workflows, research, content production, and framework maintenance. The agent client supplies reasoning and tool execution; each playbook controls artifact locations, evidence expectations, and mutation rules.
- `.claude/skills/braindump/SKILL.md`
- `.claude/skills/team-brief/SKILL.md`
- `.claude/skills/knowledge-consolidation/SKILL.md`
- `.claude/skills/update-cog/SKILL.md`

## Worker and Verification Pipeline
Complex work is delegated from a lead agent to focused workers. Workers perform I/O-heavy collection, research, file operations, approved external mutations, or publishing, writing detailed results to `/tmp` and returning a path. Independent verifiers inspect artifacts by path rather than worker narratives; fixes are bounded and harvested learning is proposal-only. This establishes a V-model: criteria/planning → build → component verification → integration/acceptance.
- `.claude/agents/worker-data-collector.md`
- `.claude/agents/worker-executor.md`
- `.claude/agents/task-verifier.md`
- `.claude/agents/integration-verifier.md`
- `.claude/agents/harvest-curator.md`

## Knowledge Evolution and CRM
Capture and intelligence artifacts feed weekly analysis and periodic consolidation into durable knowledge. The people CRM is a specialized knowledge subsystem: profiles progressively enrich based on evidence and citations, rather than treating observations as unqualified facts.
- `.claude/skills/weekly-checkin/SKILL.md`
- `.claude/skills/memory-hygiene/SKILL.md`
- `05-knowledge/consolidated/`
- `05-knowledge/people/README.md`
- `06-templates/people-profile-template.md`

## External Boundaries, Updates, and Integrity
Optional integrations include GitHub, Linear, Slack, PostHog, Jira, Confluence, Notion, museum open-data APIs, Git, and iCloud; skills should degrade when integrations are absent. `cog-update.sh` updates framework content while preserving vault data. Packaging manifests expose the plugin, while validation prevents drift across distribution surfaces.
- `cog-update.sh`
- `scripts/validate-agent-surface.sh`
- `plugin.json`
- `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`
- `docs/AGENT-SUPPORT.md`
